info.title: Alumni Tracking System API
info.description: RESTful API and Web Services for the Alumni Tracking System. Demonstrates clean MVC architecture with separated routes (routes/user.js, routes/apiUser.js), controllers (UserController, ApiUserController), and in-memory model (UserModel).
